zh-cn.meta.title: MatchCore | Minecraft 起床战争竞技匹配平台
zh-cn.meta.description: MatchCore 是 Minecraft 起床战争的竞技匹配平台：单排或组队排队，每一场对局都由服务端用加权 Elo 结算。
zh-cn.hero.title: Minecraft 起床战争竞技匹配平台
zh-cn.hero.subtitle: 排队 → 成局 → 上分。单排或组队，每一场对局都由服务端结算，计入你的分数与战绩。
zh-cn.hero.fact1.label: 对战模式
zh-cn.hero.fact2.label: 评分引擎
zh-cn.hero.fact3.label: 账号体系
zh-cn.howto.title: 怎么玩
zh-cn.howto.desc: 四步进入对局，每一步都有真实入口。
zh-cn.howto.step1.title: 注册账号
zh-cn.howto.step1.desc: 在 HRPAuth 账号门户用邮箱注册。一个账号通行整个生态。
zh-cn.howto.step2.title: 准备客户端
zh-cn.howto.step2.desc: MatchCoreArena 桌面客户端提供排队、战绩、排行榜与好友功能。尚无下载包，需按仓库文档在本地构建。
zh-cn.howto.step3.title: 登录并排队
zh-cn.howto.step3.desc: 用 HRPAuth 账号登录客户端，单排或组队进入匹配队列，按分数窗口成局。
zh-cn.howto.step4.title: 开局上分
zh-cn.howto.step4.desc: 对局移交给 Minecraft 启动器进入游戏服务器。结果自动上报，评分与排名随之更新。
zh-cn.modes.title: 玩法与段位
zh-cn.modes.desc: 目前已接通的玩法与计分方式，全部以服务端为准。
zh-cn.modes.m1.title: Bedwars 1v1
zh-cn.modes.m1.desc: 单人对抗：守护你的床，拆掉对方的床，成为最后站着的人。
zh-cn.modes.m2.title: Bedwars 2v2
zh-cn.modes.m2.desc: 双人组队：分工、资源与配合决定胜负。
zh-cn.modes.elo.title: 加权 Elo 如何计算
zh-cn.modes.elo.desc: 每场结束的对局由服务端统一结算：以 Elo 期望胜率为底，叠加生存、连胜与个人表现权重。
zh-cn.modes.elo.formula: Δ = K × (S − E) × W_round × W_streak × W_perf
zh-cn.modes.elo.l1: E：基于双方队伍平均分数的期望胜率
zh-cn.modes.elo.l2: W：生存、连胜、个人表现三类权重
zh-cn.modes.elo.l3: 客户端与游戏服不写分，结算结果计入战绩
zh-cn.modes.rank.note: 排行榜与你的名次在客户端登录后查看。
zh-cn.account.title: 账号体系与安全
zh-cn.account.desc: HRPAuth 是生态的统一认证核心：注册、登录与账号安全都在账号门户完成。
zh-cn.account.i1.title: 注册
zh-cn.account.i1.desc: 邮箱和密码注册，完成邮箱验证即可使用。
zh-cn.account.i2.title: 登录
zh-cn.account.i2.desc: 邮箱密码登录，令牌到期自动续期。
zh-cn.account.i3.title: 双因素
zh-cn.account.i3.desc: TOTP 验证器应用或 WebAuthn 通行密钥，保护账号安全。
zh-cn.eco.title: 生态入口
zh-cn.eco.wiki.title: 文档与 FAQ
zh-cn.eco.wiki.desc: 生态维基：指南、配置参考与常见问题。
zh-cn.eco.source.title: 源代码
zh-cn.eco.source.desc: 客户端与竞技场服务公开开发，问题与建议提交到议题跟踪器。
zh-cn.eco.status.title: 服务状态
zh-cn.eco.status.desc: Arena 服务的公开健康检查端点，实时可查。

en.meta.title: MatchCore | Competitive Bedwars matchmaking for Minecraft
en.meta.description: MatchCore is the competitive matchmaking platform for Minecraft Bedwars: queue solo or with a party, and every match is settled on the server with weighted Elo.
en.hero.title: The competitive Bedwars matchmaking platform for Minecraft
en.hero.subtitle: Queue up, get matched, climb the ladder. Solo or party — every match is settled on the server and counts toward your score and record.
en.hero.fact1.label: Match modes
en.hero.fact2.label: Ranking engine
en.hero.fact3.label: Accounts
en.howto.title: How It Works
en.howto.desc: Four steps into a match, each with a real entry point.
en.howto.step1.title: Create your account
en.howto.step1.desc: Register with your email at the HRPAuth account portal. One account signs you into the whole ecosystem.
en.howto.step2.title: Set up the client
en.howto.step2.desc: The MatchCoreArena desktop client covers queueing, career, rankings, and friends. No prebuilt downloads yet — build it locally following the repository docs.
en.howto.step3.title: Log in and queue
en.howto.step3.desc: Log in to the client with your HRPAuth account and queue solo or as a party; matches form by rating window.
en.howto.step4.title: Play and climb
en.howto.step4.desc: The match is handed off to your Minecraft launcher to join the game server. Results are reported automatically, and your rating and rankings update.
en.modes.title: Modes & Rating
en.modes.desc: The modes and scoring that are live today, all settled on the server.
en.modes.m1.title: Bedwars 1v1
en.modes.m1.desc: Solo combat: defend your bed, break theirs, be the last one standing.
en.modes.m2.title: Bedwars 2v2
en.modes.m2.desc: Team of two: roles, resources, and coordination decide the match.
en.modes.elo.title: How weighted Elo works
en.modes.elo.desc: Every finished match is settled on the server: Elo expected score as the base, weighted by survival, streaks, and individual performance.
en.modes.elo.formula: Δ = K × (S − E) × W_round × W_streak × W_perf
en.modes.elo.l1: E: expected score from both teams' average ratings
en.modes.elo.l2: W: survival, streak, and performance weights
en.modes.elo.l3: Clients and game servers never write scores; settled results go into your career
en.modes.rank.note: Leaderboards and your own rank are available after logging in to the client.
en.account.title: Account & Security
en.account.desc: HRPAuth is the ecosystem's unified authentication core: registration, login, and account security all happen in the account portal.
en.account.i1.title: Register
en.account.i1.desc: Sign up with email and password, verify your address, and you're in.
en.account.i2.title: Log in
en.account.i2.desc: Email and password login with automatic token refresh.
en.account.i3.title: Two-factor
en.account.i3.desc: TOTP authenticator apps or WebAuthn passkeys protect your account.
en.eco.title: Ecosystem
en.eco.wiki.title: Docs & FAQ
en.eco.wiki.desc: The ecosystem wiki: guides, configuration references, and FAQs.
en.eco.source.title: Source Code
en.eco.source.desc: The client and the arena service are developed in the open; report issues on the tracker.
en.eco.status.title: Service Status
en.eco.status.desc: The arena service's public health endpoint, checkable any time.
